title: Factorization of an independent product moment
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $U,V:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be measurable up to null sets, and suppose $U$ and $V$ are independent under $\mu$. For every natural number $p$, the integral of $|UV|^p$ equals the product of the integrals of $|U|^p$ and $|V|^p$.
hypotheses_covered: Probability measure on a measurable space
$U$ is measurable up to null sets
$V$ is measurable up to null sets
